messages:
Ravi Singh: Heads-up — autopay failed for Arcadia Labs (acct-AR12). Invoice INV-2610 for $21,450 declined: expired_card. Need quick ops: retry cadence, hosted pay link, or accept customer wire?

Nora Kim: Pulled the gateway event: ```{
"status":"failed",
"error":{"type":"card_error","code":"card_declined","decline_code":"expired_card","message":"Card has expired"},
"pm":"pm_Xy9..."
}```

Ravi Singh: CS says their AP rotated cards and treasury can push a same-day wire, but they'll need an explicit reference and confirm by email. They also asked for a temporary grace so services don't degrade.

Javier Morales: Ops recommendation: pause autopay retries and dunning, create "pending_wire" invoice state, accept wire if they provide MT103/trace, mark as pending until settlement. Optionally authorize up to $5k temp credit to avoid immediate throttling.

Lina Tran: Approve pending-wire workflow. Conditions: CS must upload bank trace to finance-wires@redwood.com; Finance will mark invoice pending and will not finalize until funds clear. Approve up to $5k emergency credit only if service disruption risk confirmed by CS.

billing-bot: Autopay retries paused. INV-2610 flagged: hold=awaiting_wire; dunning suppressed.

Nora Kim: Shared wire template with customer and requested SWIFT MT103 trace + exact amount. Template included account name, bank, acct and reference: INV-2610 / AR12. Customer acknowledged and will send trace once wire is initiated.

payments-bot: Note: If wire is received, reconcile against bank feed using reference string. If mismatch, escalate to finance-ops.

Ravi Singh: Also created a single-use hosted payment link as backup (expires 72h) — https://pay.redwood.com/t/AC34 — CS to offer link if wire delays.

Javier Morales: I'll create a pending journal entry and watch the bank feed. If customer provides trace and bank shows outbound, we'll mark "pending_wire" and release service hold. If traces show partial amount, we may apply up to $5k safety credit per Lina's approval.

Nora Kim: Customer sent MT103 trace at 13:02 UTC. Uploaded to finance-wires@ and CRM. Will update once reconciliation confirms.

Lina Tran: Thanks — keep thread updated. Once payment posts, remove hold and close thread. :white_check_mark:
